description_ar: دعوة لفعالية أو مناسبة: اسم الفعالية بتوهج، التاريخ والوقت والمكان تتابعاً، وزر تسجيل.
description_en: Invitation to an event: glowing event name, date / time / place revealed in sequence and a register button.
scene_blueprint_en: Scene 1: invitation line + event name with a glowing title.
Scene 2: date, time and place as three staggered lines (slide-right, 0.4 s apart) + a register button.
Optional scene 3: speakers / sponsors list or a countdown.
rules_en: Use emoji pictograms sparingly (calendar, clock, pin) at the start of the lines.
The button label is a verb (سجّل الآن).
